messages.subject: Scaling Acme Retail’s global checkout experience
messages.body:
Hi Sarah,

I work with retailers scaling their e-commerce platforms globally. I noticed Acme Retail has recently expanded into Europe — congrats!

I’d love to show you how Stripe can simplify cross-border payments, optimize conversion rates, and keep you compliant with PSD2/SCA.

Would you be open to a quick 20-minute intro call this week?

Best, 
Alex Chen
Account Executive | Stripe

messages.subject: Re: Scaling Acme Retail’s global checkout experience
messages.body:
Hi Alex,

Yes, we’re evaluating providers for EU payments. Can you send over some material before we schedule a call?

Thanks, 
Sarah

messages.subject: Re: Scaling Acme Retail’s global checkout experience
messages.body: Quick follow-up: attaching requested details and next steps.

Regards,
John Miller
Solutions Engineer | Stripe

messages.subject: Webhook reliability and idempotency keys
messages.body:
Hi Nina,

Following up on your questions: Stripe retries on 3xx/4xx/5xx per exponential backoff; idempotency keys ensure safe retries for POST requests.

Here are best practices and example code.

— John

messages.subject: Re: Webhook reliability and idempotency keys
messages.body:
Thanks John. We’ll test multi-tenant flows and sign webhook secrets per env. Could we also review Radar rules for healthcare patterns?

— Nina
